meta.title: INDEX 350 — W2 Performance Review & W3 Candidate Selection
meta.policy: Historical W2 review/selection artifact. W3 source release was explicitly manually approved; no real W2 GSC/indexation performance is claimed.

clusterPolicy.note: Minima prevent one product family from dominating W3. Remaining slots may be filled adaptively from healthy reserve candidates.

selectionRules: Only C_MODEL candidates with releaseState HOLD_PLANNED are eligible for W3 selection.
Candidate parent must already be LIVE before W3; same-wave parent creation is not allowed in this selector.
ROUND3_REVIEW_ELIGIBLE from the real W2 Observation Gate is required before SELECT decisions are emitted.
If a candidate parent is one of the 50 W2 URLs, that parent must be indexed and must not be implicated in OWNERSHIP_REVIEW.
A W2 parent with visibility or EARLY_SIGNAL receives additional score but visibility is not an individual hard blocker once the global observation gate has passed.
Known static ownership-risk candidates are blocked until manual review.
Cluster minima must be satisfied before a 50-page selection can be declared complete.
No candidate is published, indexed, added to sitemap, or canonicalized by this review/selection batch.
No automatic W3 release, merge, redirect, noindex, or canonical switch.
